profile.headline: Software Engineer II
profile.summary: My Name is Eric Fracek. I’m currently a Software Engineer at Andersen Corporation. I have a passion for cutting edge technology and connecting with people. My goal is to create software that will enhance people's lives by overcoming barriers and creating solutions to everyday problems. Additionally, I enjoy traveling the US in my 40 ft school bus conversion, hiking, and getting to know new people.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Administered instances of Rockwell Automation’s FactoryTalk ProductionCentre using Red Hat JBoss EAP.
- Planned and implemented system upgrades for 24/7 manufacturing sites.
- Created integrated solutions for IT and manufacturing needs including an internal website to track and monitor manufacturing systems using ReactJS, PowerShell, and MS SQL.
- Provided daytime and on call support for a nationwide manufacturing base with 13+ locations and 2000+ concurrent users.
- Refactored existing ERP integration from BaanV to FactoryTalk ProductionCentre using FactoryTalk Services Platform.
- Developed OPC UA machine integrations using ISA95 Job Control.
- Refactored existing ERP integration from BaanV to FactoryTalk ProductionCentre using FactoryTalk Services Platform.
- Developed OPC UA machine integrations using ISA95 Job Control.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented a local messaging server in JavaScript with real time messaging through Apollo GraphQL, MongoDB, and ReactJS using Node.js and Express.
- Updated existing infrastructure to allow employees to work remotely during the COVID-19 pandemic using OpenVPN and VNC.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
- Tutored students in several languages including C++, Java, JavaScript, and Python. 
- Assisted students in debugging programs and best practice programming. 
- Reviewed central computer science concepts with students to ensure a solid understanding.
